en: A black‑and‑white historic postcard-style image of an outdoor café garden. The foreground shows carefully arranged flowerbeds and manicured lawns, with a path curving between circular and oval beds edged with low flowers. On the left a girl in a dress stands with a large dog and a basket; on the right another person walks along the path. Behind them is a vast seating area filled with many light-colored wooden tables and chairs set beneath tall leafy trees. In the background stands a large, elegant building with a glass pavilion or conservatory façade and classical architectural details. Signs among the trees read "Eis‑Café," indicating an ice‑cream café.
